title: Cientista de Dados PL
description:
Cientista de Dados - Machine Learning


Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados talentoso e inovador para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve ter sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning, com habilidades em classificação, Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), técnicas estatísticas e validação de modelos. Esperamos que você tenha um forte entendimento de feature engineering e métricas de desempenho.


Responsabilidades:


- Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Modelos: Construir, treinar e validar modelos de machine learning, aplicando técnicas avançadas de classificação e NLP para resolver problemas complexos de negócios.

- Trabalho com Linguagens e Bibliotecas: Utilizar Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas e numpy, além de frameworks de NLP para desenvolver soluções eficientes e escaláveis.

- Integração de IA Generativa e LLMs: Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs) e IA Generativa, utilizando APIs e técnicas de prompt engineering para avaliação e integração de respostas em pipelines analíticos.

- Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura em Cloud: Atuar em ambientes de computação em nuvem, especialmente utilizando AWS, S3, SageMaker e Glue, para otimizar processos de dados e Machine Learning.

- Arquitetura de Soluções: Projetar e implementar soluções end-to-end, criando pipelines analíticos e integrando modelos em ambientes produtivos para maximizar a eficiência operacional.

Além das habilidades técnicas, o candidato deve possuir competências profissionais como comunicação técnica clara, autonomia para tomar decisões e a capacidade de atuar em contextos de negócios complexos.


Se você é apaixonado por dados e tecnologia, e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica que valoriza a inovação, se inscreva!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios Pleno | Produto RH
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Buscamos um profissional estratégico-analítico para atuar na inteligência de expansão das soluções de RH. Este perfil não apenas organiza a rotina, mas provoca o crescimento através da análise de dados, monitoramento da saúde da base e suporte crítico à tomada de decisão da Coordenação. Espera-se maturidade para interlocução com líderes comerciais e senso de dono para garantir a rentabilidade e competitividade das ofertas.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

Inteligência Comercial e Gestão de Forecast:

  • Avaliar criticamente as solicitações de descontos, utilizando dados de margem e histórico de negociações para fundamentar recomendações de aprovação ou veto à coordenação.
  • Consolidar indicadores de performance (KPIs) da rede, transformando dados brutos em insights acionáveis para reuniões de diretoria.
  • Forecast: Apoiar na organização e acompanhamento do pipeline comercial
  • Inteligência Competitiva: \"Realizar benchmarking constante de soluções HXM no mercado, identificando diferenciais competitivos e gaps no nosso portfólio para municiar a coordenação com argumentos de defesa de valor e combate à concorrência.\"
  • Governança: Acompanhar e apoiar a Coordenação nos rituais de governança com as unidades de negócio (DRGs/Franquias), garantindo que as políticas de precificação e as regras de engajamento comercial sejam cumpridas de forma padronizada, reduzindo a necessidade de intervenção direta da coordenação em temas recorrentes

Gestão Estratégica da Base (Foco em CS e Expansão):

  • Analisar a taxa de ocupação e o comportamento de uso das soluções, apoiando no desenho planos de ação para Cross-sell e Up-sell em contas estratégicas.
  • Propor melhorias nos fluxos operacionais (propostas, contratação e faturamento) para reduzir o atrito e acelerar o time-to-revenue.

Articulação e Influência (Postura de Liderança):

  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico de produtos de RH perante o time comercial e áreas transversais (CS, Finanças, Produto).
  • Posicionar-se em fóruns de decisão, defendendo diretrizes comerciais e garantindo o alinhamento das unidades com a estratégia de expansão da companhia.

Capacitação do time de AR

  • Disseminar boas práticas e conteúdos técnicos de forma propositiva, elevando o nível de maturidade comercial da rede.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Capacidade Analítica: Conforto em trabalhar com dados para defender pontos de vista.
  • Resiliência e Firmeza: Habilidade para dizer \"não\" a pedidos comerciais que fogem da regra, embasando a decisão com lógica técnica.
  • Domínio de HR Tech: Entender as dores de um RH (Recrutamento, Treinamento, Payroll, etc.) para falar a língua do cliente e do time comercial.
  • Produtividade: Boa organização e capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas
  • Comunicação: Comunicação clara e facilidade de interação com diferentes áreas
  • Experiência com análise de dados e acompanhamento de dashboards comerciais
  • Vivência com fluxos de aprovação e processos de governança comercial
  • Noções de pricing (formação de preço, descontos, margem)
  • Experiência em operações comerciais estruturadas (Sales Ops / RevOps)
  • Perfil com viés de Customer Success, com boa gestão de interações e stakeholders


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

title: Bolsista Graduado Engenharia de Software - Grupo Boticário - Avanços em dados e produtos digitais para P&D - Talento Inovação IEL PR

Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. Sobre a Oportunidade:


O Grupo Boticário é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do Brasil e referência em inovação, tecnologia e desenvolvimento de soluções que impulsionam a pesquisa e o negócio. Em um ambiente dinâmico e estratégico, a companhia investe continuamente em iniciativas que fortalecem sua transformação digital e ampliam sua capacidade de gerar valor por meio de dados.

Buscamos um bolsista para atuar em um projeto voltado à internalização e evolução de uma plataforma de dados e produtos digitais para P&D, apoiando a estruturação de processos, a automação de rotinas e a geração de insights para acelerar decisões e resultados.

Essa é uma oportunidade para contribuir com um projeto de alto impacto, conectando tecnologia, Engenharia de Software, ciência de dados e inovação em um dos maiores ecossistemas de beleza do país. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação no Grupo Boticário!


Projeto: Projeto de avanços em dados e produtos digitais para P&D


Formação Acadêmica:

Graduado em Engenheiro de Software, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Idioma:


Principais Atividades:

  • Executar testes de carga, testes unitários e de integração em ambiente de homologação;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do código-fonte e da arquitetura da solução;
  • Criar manuais de utilização para os usuários pesquisadores;
  • Apoiar a TI do Grupo Boticário na configuração da infraestrutura em nuvem e no deploy dos contêineres Docker;
  • Liderar a transição dos repositórios e ativos técnicos do parceiro tecnológico para o ambiente interno do Grupo Boticário;
  • Trabalho com o time para manter a operação e sustentação da plataforma;
  • Desenvolver soluções de automação e inteligência para subprocessos manuais de P&D;
  • Propor ideias e análises que apoiem a geração de insights.


Conhecimento Necessário:

  • Graduação completo em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento Back-end com Python 3.12+, Django e Django REST Framework;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Front-end com ReactJS e TypeScript, com uso de Design System;
  • Experiência com conteinerização de aplicações utilizando Docker e versionamento com Git;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em PostgreSQL, incluindo modelagem, queries e otimização;
  • Conhecimento básico ou intermediário em ferramentas de nuvem, como AWS e GCP.



Conhecimento Desejável:

  • Experiência com análise de dados científicos, especialmente biológicos ou químicos;
  • Vivência com manipulação de Big Data;
  • Domínio em pipelines de processamento e integração de bases heterogêneas;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de nuvem e orquestração de contêineres, como Kubernetes;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de monitoramento e observabilidade;
  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em ferramentas de análise de dados e relatórios, como Google Sheets, Looker e App Sheet;
  • Conhecimento básico ou intermediário em linguagens e ferramentas voltadas à análise de dados, como SQL e Python;
  • Ter mestrado na área será um diferencial.


Valor da Bolsa (graduado): R$4.000,00

Formato de trabalho : Remoto.

Soft Skills : Proativo, Comunicação, trabalho em grupo, Flexibilidade, Agilidade, Resiliência.

  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Collaborate through pair programming and support onboarding when needed.
  • Deploy user-facing code to production responsibly.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineering leadership, and stakeholders across regions.
  • Ensure observability and reliability by learning from metrics and incidents and maintaining systems.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and engineering workflows.
  • Continuously learn and apply new technologies, patterns, and initiatives.


Required Qualifications

title: AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer


We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Location : Remote, open to candidates based in Brazil and the Philippines.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development:

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems:

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion.
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Exposure to MLOps best practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning, GANs, or edge AI deployments.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray.
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first.
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.

description:

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior AppSec Analyst (BRL 17K/month CLT + benefits)
description:
1-2X/WEEK AT THE OFFICE, NEAR PAULISTA AVENUE (CONSOLAÇÃO STATION)

Purpose of the job


As a DevSecOps Engineer, you’ll contribute to a security-first approach. This is an opportunity to shape the foundations of a resilient platform with security embedded throughout the software development lifecycle, implementing automated security controls and establishing security best practices.


This hands-on role requires security by design, championing shift-left security practices and establishing security automation across our route to live, incorporating static and dynamic security testing, vulnerability management and remediation, and improvements on current security posture and compliance.


You’ll benefit from fresh thinking with the opportunity to include pioneering innovative security approaches, with the freedom to explore AI.

If you're passionate about building secure-by-design systems, defining robust secure platforms, and leading the way in implementing security as code, this role offers the opportunity to do just that.


Key Responsibilities

● Security Strategy - Being the authority on running a secure platform and the technical security strategy, leading in improving and implementing security best practices such as AWS Well-Architected framework, zero trust principles, least privilege access control and disaster recovery within our platforms.

● Collaboration - Serve as the primary technical security liaison between engineering teams and security leadership, working closely with the CISO and assurance/governance teams to align security priorities with business objectives and risk management strategies

● Secure Development Practices - Champion security-first design patterns, integrate automated security testing and compliance validation into CI/CD pipelines, and implement GitOps security practices. Ensure deployments are secure-by-default with automated security gates, vulnerability scanning, and continuous compliance monitoring. This means writing real code, building proof-of-concepts, and diving into problem-solving.

● Security Evangelisation, Visualisation and Consistency - evangelising a security-conscious culture within our development teams. Develop and maintain security posture reporting and metrics that provide meaningful insights to stakeholders and guide development teams in implementing security best practices

● AI & Future Tech - We want to push the boundaries of AI-driven development - if you have ideas on how to embed AI into our security processes, you’ll have the space to explore them.


Your experience


● Tech stack - We use Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Python, AWS, Windows and Linux OS, Github Actions & Bitbucket Pipelines. You’re comfortable with all of these, and have extensive knowledge in Terraform and IaC principles, with extensive knowledge of CI/CD and the AWS ecosystem. Experience with TypeScript & Java is advantageous.

● Proven experience integrating security practices into the software development lifecycle, and you are proficient with compliance frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Top 10 & PCI DSS (v4). Experience with threat modelling is advantageous.

● Proven experience with secure cloud configuration and management of AWS services, familiarity with Network security, Encryption, Identity & Access Management

● Security Tooling & Automation - You have proven experience working with automating and configuring security tooling such as Vulnerability Management, Penetration Testing, DAST, SAST, & SIEM/SOC. Experience with Rapid7 Platform, Crowdstrike and Datadog is advantageous.

● CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code - You’ve deployed secure production systems using Terraform, Ansible and Helm, are comfortable with Linux and Windows based operating systems and have strong experience with CI/CD providers baking in security best practices.

● Observability Mindset - You believe in measuring everything. You’ve worked with DataDog, Rapid7 (or similar) to ensure teams have visibility into platform security.

title: Global Therapist: Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR)
description:
Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health. At Spring Health, we’re on a mission to revolutionize mental healthcare by removing every barrier that prevents people from getting the help they need, when they need it. Our clinically validated technology, Precision Mental Healthcare, empowers us to deliver the right care at the right time—whether it’s therapy, coaching, medication, or beyond—tailored to each individual’s needs. We proudly partner with over 450 companies, from startups to multinational Fortune 500 corporations, as a leading provider of mental health service, providing care for 10 million people. Our clients include brands you use and know like Microsoft, Target, and Delta Airlines, all of whom trust us to deliver best-in-class outcomes for their employees globally. With our innovative platform, we’ve been able to generate a net positive ROI for employers and we are the only company in our category to earn external validation of net savings for customers. We have raised capital from prominent investors including Generation Investment, Kinnevik, Tiger Global, William K Warren Foundation, Northzone, RRE Ventures, and many more. Thanks to their partnership and our latest Series E Funding, our current valuation has reached $3.3 billion. We’re just getting started—join us on our journey to make mental healthcare accessible to everyone, everywhere.


What You'll Do:

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.
  • Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR) is a specialized service you can offer through Spring Health. It involves providing timely support to employees at organizations that are navigating workplace-related crises at both the macro level (natural disasters, civil unrest, etc.) and micro level (workforce reductions, death of a co-worker, etc.).
  • Employers might request your support for in-person or virtual group sessions, or 1:1 check-ins. This can include:
  • Group Support: Typically a 1-hour debriefing session with additional resources and follow-up care available through Spring Health.
  • 1:1 Support: 15-minute check-ins with the goal of normalizing the employee’s experience and connecting them to Spring Health for follow-up care if it's appropriate.

Who You Are:

  • You have an unrestricted license to practice counseling (Psychologist, Masters level counselor, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring licensed supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure)
  • Minimum 3 years of total experience within mental health.
  • Have a dedicated office space in which to provide in-person therapy if you choose to provide those services.
  • You're comfortable with technology and are tele-health competent.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.
  • Previous experience delivering CIR services is preferred
  • You must be willing to travel up to one hour from your home to customer locations for delivery of in-person CIR services


Benefits of working with Spring Health:

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!


Not sure if you meet every requirement? Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.



Ready to do the most impactful work of your life? Learn more about our values, what it’s like to work here, and how hyper-growth meets impact at Spring Health: Our Values



Our privacy policy:



Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Ingeniero IaC — Terraform & Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
description:
Sobre a VMetrix

A VMetrix é uma Fintech B2B que está transformando a forma como as instituições financeiras gerenciam investimentos, risco e tesouraria. Nossa plataforma SaaS Front to Back to Risk permite que bancos, seguradoras, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e outras instituições financeiras implementem tecnologia de nível mundial em meses, não em anos, com um modelo flexível e escalável.

O Papel

Você será o arquiteto e guardião da infraestrutura cloud da VMetrix. Automatizará, provisionará e gerenciará todos os recursos OCI por meio do Terraform, garantindo ambientes reproduzíveis, seguros e altamente disponíveis que sustentam nossa plataforma financeira crítica.

  • 5+ anos em infraestrutura cloud (comprovável)

  • 5+ anos de domínio prático de Terraform (módulos, remote state, workspaces, backends)

  • Networking: VCN, subnets, Security Lists, NSGs, IGW, NAT GW, Service GW, DRG

Terraform & IaC — Domínio avançado

  • Variables, outputs, módulos, remote state, terraform.tfvars, backends OCI Object Storage
  • Gestão de múltiplos workspaces e ambientes (Dev / QA / Prod)

Segurança Cloud

  • IAM policies, criptografia KMS/Vault, Audit Service no OCI

  • Gestão de segredos: OCI Vault e/ou HashiCorp Vault


Perfil Diferencial — O que coloca você à frente:

  • Ex-funcionário ou ex-contratado da Oracle com experiência em suporte, implementação ou arquitetura OCI → MÁXIMO diferencial do processo
  • Portfólio comprovado em OCI + Terraform (repositórios Git públicos, artigos, open source)

  • Containers: Docker e Kubernetes / OKE
  • Contribuições à comunidade (blog, meetups, palestras sobre OCI ou Terraform)


Certificações - Altamente desejáveis:

  • OCI Architect Professional (1Z0-997)
  • OCI DevOps Professional (1Z0-1109)
  • OCI Security Professional (1Z0-1104)
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003)


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix


En VMetrix não buscamos fazer “mais barulho”, mas construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relacionamentos de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, VMetrix é o lugar certo.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
Hardware Electronics Engineer


Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus


Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil

Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM

Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience)

Type Full-Time, On-Site

Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus


About Quectel

Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular IoT modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud.


A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus

This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now.

Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America.


Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here.


Learn more about Quectel:

  • Company website — quectel.com
  • Our history & global footprint — quectel.com/company/history
  • LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric LatAm customer story (Brazil)
  • Follow us on


The Role

We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial IoT, connected payments, and more.

Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market.


\"Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay.\"


What You'll Do

  • Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions.
  • Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs.
  • Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues.
  • Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams.
  • Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities.
  • Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster.
  • Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM.
  • Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles.
  • Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces.
  • Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis.
  • Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug.
  • Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes.
  • Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS).
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.


Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing PCBA end-to-end.
  • Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C.
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO.
  • RF testing experience across cellular (2G/3G/4G/5G) and Wi-Fi 802.11.
  • Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration.
  • Prior ANATEL homologation experience.
  • Team leadership or technical mentoring experience.


The Tech You'll Work With

  • Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas.
  • Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies.
  • See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more.


Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it.
  • Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM.
  • Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed IoT company behind you.
  • Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem.
  • Cutting-edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices.
  • Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales.
  • Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products.
  • Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent).
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows.


Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis.


Apply via: | Browse open roles: quectel.com/recruitment


Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: Emerging Market Trader - LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in LATAM currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities:


FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on LATAM markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:

  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.

Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.


Requirements

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.

Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS)

Experience working at:

  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks

Hands-on experience building or optimizing:

  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.

Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: Analista Financeiro de Orçamento Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaboração e divulgação de relatórios com análise de resultados mensais acompanhando o real x orçado das unidades de negócios/shoppings e departamentos;
  • Apoiar a elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações;
  • Participar da construção do orçamento anual (Budget) e projeções periódicas (Forecast);
  • Apoiar e participar do acompanhamento do resultado operacional (NOI), assegurando aderência ao orçamento aprovado e a avaliação de distorções;
  • Atuar com perfil analítico, visão crítica e atenção a detalhes elaborando análises financeiras, identificando variações, causas dos desvios e propondo ações corretivas quando aplicável;
  • Manter relacionamento contínuo com as diversas áreas da companhia, atuando de forma colaborativa, com postura proativa e orientação a resultados;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria dos controles internos, por meio da revisão de processos e implementação de automatizações, com foco na eficiência operacional e na governança dos dados.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel avançado e conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas de visualização de dados serão um diferencial;
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com boa capacidade de comunicação.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.


Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Finance Data Specialist
description:
Nosso time de Dados

Nosso time de dados é responsável por empoderar as equipes da Nuvemshop para tomarem as melhores decisões, transformando dados em acionáveis. Trabalhamos em colaboração para ajudar a criar uma cultura de trabalho apoiada em dados, que lhes permite atingir seus objetivos de forma eficiente, fornecendo a infraestrutura e as ferramentas necessárias para apoiar essas equipes.


O tamanho do seu desafio

  • Ser ponto focal da equipe de Analytics para Finance, atuando como referência técnica e estratégica na identificação proativa de problemas de negócio;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e a manutenção de modelos financeiros e análises preditivas que suportem decisões estratégicas de receita, custos e investimentos;
  • Implementar as melhores práticas de visualização de dados para criar insights significativos e torná-los acionáveis;
  • Construir soluções com novas métricas e painéis de controle que ajudem as equipes de Finance a tomarem as melhores decisões;
  • Conduzir análises de variância (real vs. orçado) e identificar oportunidades de otimização de custos e melhoria de margens;
  • Encontrar 80/20s que possam maximizar o ROI do que fazemos;
  • Encontrar correlações entre diferentes ações e resultados financeiros com foco em rentabilidade, fluxo de caixa e eficiência operacional;
  • Automatizar processos de reporting financeiro e reduzir dependência de análises manuais, propondo soluções escaláveis;
  • Melhorar o que entendemos sobre o negócio para desbloquear novas possibilidades.


O que buscamos

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL;
  • Experiência em DBT para modelagem de dados;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (preferencialmente Tableau);
  • Experiência trabalhando com equipes financeiras, com entendimento aprofundado de conceitos como P&L, forecast, budget, unit economics e análise de variância;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de FP&A ou ERPs;
  • Base sólida em estatística descritiva e modelagem financeira;
  • Capacidade de abstrair e focar em informações/fatos relevantes em uma ampla gama de dados;
  • Habilidade comprovada de influenciar stakeholders e traduzir dados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis para liderança;
  • Histórico de atuação autônoma em projetos complexos, com capacidade de definir escopo, priorizar entregas e conduzir análises end-to-end;
  • Excelentes habilidades de relacionamento, colaboração e planejamento.


São diferenciais

  • Conhecimento de Python para análise;
  • Experiência aplicando inteligência artificial generativa (GenAI) para acelerar análises de dados, automação de workflows ou geração de insights;
  • Experiência em e-commerce ou empresas de tecnologia SaaS.


Nosso processo

Queremos que você tenha a melhor experiência possível ao longo do nosso processo seletivo. Após a sua inscrição, o time de Talent Acquisition irá analisar seu perfil com atenção e, independentemente do resultado, você receberá um retorno. As etapas e prazos podem variar de acordo com cada vaga, mas não se preocupe — que nos manteremos em contato com você.


O que temos para você

  • Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash Benefícios: Plataforma que reúne vale alimentação, vale refeição e outras categorias como educação, entretenimento, cultura, saúde, bem-estar, auxílio home office e muito mais;
  • Aulas de espanhol semanais gratuitas;
  • Totalpass: As melhores redes de parcerias para atividades físicas, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e qualidade do sono, com diversos planos disponíveis;
  • Descontos nos cursos da Coderhouse;
  • Auxílio creche para crianças de até 5 anos;
  • Licença de família estendida para 21 dias corridos para pessoas não grávidas ou adotantes. A licença maternidade é de 4 meses e a licença parental de 21 dias. O benefício também vale para famílias que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homoafetivos;
  • Além das férias, temos uma semana de descanso para recarregar as energias no final/começo do ano;
  • Uma Nuvemshop gratuita para você ou pessoa próxima;
  • Somos #remotefirst - o que significa que damos prioridade ao trabalho remoto dentro do país de contratação, sempre que a função permitir;
  • E um ambiente de desafio contínuo, propósito e protagonismo — aqui você é livre para pensar grande e ter atitude gigante.

title: Executivo de Vendas Mid-Market
description:
Na ADP, somos movidos pelo seu sucesso. Envolvemos seus talentos e perspectivas únicos. Acolhemos suas ideias para fazer as coisas de modo diferente e melhor. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso te motiva, você pertence à ADP.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

description:

Build and progressively expand the portfolio of local business partners in the respective market territories. Ensuring our partnerships' success and building strong, working relationships with both supplier and demand channel partners. You are a true market development leader who has a broad network of connections in the travel industry, keen sense of the pulse of the industry, passion to be successful, and sense of opportunity.


Your mission:

Identify market opportunities, win new business and establish strong successful partnerships. In particular, B2B and B2C travel partners, Online Travel Agencies, Travel content suppliers, Airlines etc

  • High impact, dynamic person, with a record of achieving results individually.

  • Founded in 2023, Aerohub is a Non-GDS flight content aggregator focusing on Low-cost and API connected carriers. Our vision is provide unique depth of content , enabling our partners to better service end users/ consumers, thereby Improving profitability.


Detail Role & Responsibilities

  • Review with internal stakeholders on project progress. Leading discussions as “voice of customer”, aligning on next steps and targets

Market development

  • Seek out business growth opportunities for Aerohub/ Letsfly in own region through contact networking, industry networks. Manage active partnership pipelines and provide clear visibility to internal stakeholders.
  • Actively and proactively approach potential business partners that fit Aerohub’s partnership needs. Perform initial qualification and potential collaboration discussions. Provide brief to internal teams to come up with partnership proposal (including technical, product and commercial collaboration models)
  • Pitch partnership proposal to potential external partners, introduce and work with relevant internal teams to work on refining proposition and proposals.
  • Close the deal, manage objections.

Como QA no nosso time, você será o guardião da experiência do usuário e da estabilidade técnica, atuando em todas as frentes da pirâmide de testes.


Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Automação Estratégica: Desenvolver e impulsionar a criação de testes automatizados de ponta a ponta (E2E, API e Performance).

  • Evangelização da Qualidade: Influenciar o time e defender a qualidade como uma responsabilidade compartilhada, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Mindset de Aprendizado: Buscar constantemente novas soluções e tecnologias para otimizar nossos processos de automação.


Requisitos Imprescindíveis:

  • Experiência sólida com frameworks de automação de testes (RobotFramework, Cypress, Selenium, Playwright ou similares);
  • Mindset de Eficiência: Experiência ou forte interesse em trabalhar com ferramentas de AI-Assisted Development integradas ao fluxo de trabalho (IDE), visando aumentar a cobertura de testes e reduzir o tempo de entrega (Time-to-Market);

title: Senior Writer
description:
Senior Writer (Roteirista)

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.


Role Overview

As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

title: Data & AI Tech Lead
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente
