title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Able seaman
description:
Position: Able Seaman
Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 57 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Able Seaman supports deck operations, ensuring proper maintenance and operation of deck equipment, lifting appliances, and lifesaving systems. The role contributes to cargo handling, emergency preparedness, and compliance with safety and operational standards onboard.
Key Responsibilities
Inspect, test, and operate survival craft, rescue boats, and other lifesaving appliances in accordance with the maintenance plan;
Assist in material handling and lifting operations onboard;
Support housekeeping activities and waste management, including proper segregation and disposal;
Operate pedestal crane for ship-to-ship operations in the absence of the designated Crane Operator (e. G., during rest periods), subject to required qualifications;
Operate electro-mechanical lifting equipment (excluding pedestal cranes);
Participate actively in emergency response activities, including fire drills, abandon ship drills, and other onboard emergency procedures;
Maintain lifeboats, liferafts, and other safety equipment in a state of readiness;
Ensure familiarity with all safety equipment and applicable procedures onboard;
Perform routine maintenance tasks such as chipping, painting, cleaning, and greasing;
Maintain deck equipment and carry out minor repairs as required.
Requirements
Valid certification as Able Seaman (in accordance with STCW requirements);
Previous offshoreexperience (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Experience with deck operations and lifting equipment;
Familiarity with safety procedures and emergency response onboard;
Good level of physical fitness and ability to work in offshore conditions;
Basic English communication skills (minimum intermediate level preferred);
Strong teamwork, discipline, and safety-oriented mindset.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Electrical engineer
description:
Position: Electrical Engineer
Location: Rio de Janeiro - Barra da Tijuca
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Electrical Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems onboard the FPSO, contributing to performance improvement, asset integrity, and operational efficiency. The role provides technical analysis and engineering support to ensure compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
Key Responsibilities
Support FPSO performance and safety by analysing MOCs (Management of Change), TQs (Technical Queries), and NOIs (Notification of Incidents), providing technical recommendations to the operations team;
Develop technicalsolutions and engineering studies related to electrical systems to resolve operational issues onboard the FPSO;
Provide technicalsupport to offshore teams in the implementation of electrical improvements, testing, and system optimization;
Investigate electrical failures and incidents, performing root cause analysis and proposing corrective actions;
Prepare and review electrical engineering documentation such as P& IDs, electrical datasheets, equipment specifications, Cause & Effect diagrams, and electrical SOPs;
Participate in risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, HIRA, TRA), ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations, including NR-10 and NR-12.
Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering;
Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Advanced English;
Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail;
Strong analyticaland problem-solving skills;
Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies;
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software;
Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work.
Nice to have
Knowledge of power generation systems, load shedding, switchboards, or HV/LV electrical systems.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

description:
Na ADP, somos movidos pelo seu sucesso. Envolvemos seus talentos e perspectivas únicos. Acolhemos suas ideias para fazer as coisas de modo diferente e melhor. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso te motiva, você pertence à ADP.
Nos esforçamos para que cada interação seja motivada pelos nossos valores CENTRAIS: Conhecimento e Visão, Integridade é Tudo, Excelência na Prestação de Serviços, Inovação Inspiradora, Cada Pessoa Conta, Orientação a Resultados e Responsabilidade Social.
Nossa cultura acolhe diversas perspectivas e cria um lugar onde as carreiras podem florescer. Nós respeitamos e valorizamos as diferenças com oportunidades iguais de emprego, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, cultura, deficiência ou status social.
Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso. Faça parte do nosso time!

RESUMO DA VAGA
Nós estamos procurando por um executivo de vendas para os nossos contratos com empresas globais e multinacionais. Esta pessoa será responsável pela prospecção de novos clientes no Estado do Rio de Janeiro, geração de novos leads na indústria de serviço em empresas mid-market e pelo relacionamento com executivos de alto escalão.
É necessário conhecimento aprofundado dos produtos da ADP e seus escopos versus forças/fraquezas de nossos competidores. Além disso, é importante o estabelecimento de relacionamento aprofundado com prospects e clientes.
RESPONSABILIDADES
Desenvolver plano de negócios anual, determinando metas de vendas e ações para o atingimento da cota estabelecida; alcançar e superar cota através da carteira designada;
Produzir um Relatório de Empresas a Prospectar em 120 Dias, o qual identifique empresas em potencial e as ações para fechamento de contrato;
Assegurar gerenciamento, planejamento e feedbacks constantes a respeito da carteira de clientes;
Identificar insatisfação dos clientes em relação aos produtos e serviços existentes e executar plano de ações a fim de resolver problemas e reter clientes;
Gerar vendas para novos e atuais clientes enquanto garante alta satisfação.
REQUISITOS:
Experiência como sales hunter
Experiência com vendas com 100% de prospecção de novos clientes;
Inglês avançado ou fluente;
Experiência com cold calls;
Experiência com vendas complexas e ciclos de venda de pelo menos 3 meses para clientes Enterprise
Formação superior completa
Disponibilidade para visitas a clientes e reuniões presenciais semanais na região do Botafogo .

title: Analista de r&s senior
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.
No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR). Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação. No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Eko Truck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.
A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Identificar melhorias no processo de atração e seleção, acompanhando indicadores e planos de ação.

title: Operations assistant – rezeption & buchhaltung
description:

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company’s institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS’s institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Consultor(a) de educação internacional sr - stb
description:
O STB é líder no segmento de educação internacional no Brasil, com mais de 50 cidades atendidas, dois escritórios na Austrália e referência nacional em atendimento online. Desde 1971, conectamos estudantes e profissionais ao mundo por meio de programas de intercâmbio educacional e trabalho no exterior. Somos parte do ecossistema Be Fly , um dos maiores hubs de turismo e experiências da América Latina, que integra marcas inovadoras com foco em tecnologia, eficiência operacional e excelência em serviço.
Sobre a vaga A posição de Consultor(a) de Educação Internacional Sr é fundamental para impulsionar os resultados comerciais do STB – Be Fly . Essa pessoa será responsável por realizar atendimento consultivo a clientes interessados em programas de intercâmbio, mapear perfil, objetivos e orçamento para indicar as melhores opções de destino e curso, conduzir apresentações de escolas e universidades no exterior e atuar em negociações de maior complexidade. Também apoiará o gestor no acompanhamento de metas, garantindo a gestão do funil de vendas no sistema e participando de eventos e ações de divulgação da loja.
Confira As Principais Atividades Desta Vaga
Realizar atendimento consultivo a clientes interessados em programas de intercâmbio.
Mapear perfil, objetivos e orçamento do cliente para indicar a melhor opção de programa e destino.
Conduzir apresentações detalhadas de cursos, escolas, universidades e processos de aplicação.
Atuar em negociações de maior complexidade, assegurando o equilíbrio entre satisfação do cliente e políticas comerciais da empresa.
Apoiar o gestor da loja no acompanhamento das metas e resultados.
Acompanhar todo o funil de vendas no sistema interno, garantindo atualização das informações e controle do pipeline.
Participar de eventos, feiras e ações de divulgação da loja.
Curtiu?! Vamos em frente, entenda o que esperamos de você:
Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas em intercâmbio;
Histórico sólido de atingimento de metas e resultados comerciais;
Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
Organização, visão analítica e habilidade de negociação;
Inglês avançado.
Diferenciais
Vivência internacional (como intercambista ou acadêmica).
Conhecimento em processos de aplicação para escolas no exterior.
Conhecimento em Higher Education e outros tipos de programas complexos.
Quais os benefícios de ser Be Flyer?
VR Ifood benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela Be Fly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com coparticipação.
Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
Assistência odontológica | Odonto Prev.
Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.
Be Flyers Travel | Agência de lazer interna com condições especiais para colaboradores.
E muito mais!
Se você busca desenvolvimento na Consultor(a) de Educação Internacional, quer atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e contribuir para uma empresa que conecta pessoas ao mundo, essa oportunidade pode ser o seu próximo passo.
Candidate-se e venha fazer parte do STB!
The Pursuit of Better has no finish line.

title: Analista de employer branding e comunicação interna senior
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.
No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR). Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação. No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Eko Truck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.
A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.
Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de Especialista em Operações Comerciais abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso:
Sua missão: Employer Branding
Apoiar o desenvolvimento e execução da estratégia de marca empregadora
Criar e gerir conteúdos para redes sociais e página de carreiras
Desenvolver e divulgar histórias de colaboradores (cases, depoimentos, bastidores)
Apoiar a participação em rankings, prêmios e iniciativas de reputação empregadora
Atuar na mobilização de colaboradores como embaixadores da marca Comunicação Interna e Endomarketing
Planejar e executar campanhas internas alinhadas à cultura e aos objetivos do negócio
Estruturar e acompanhar calendário de comunicação interna
Produzir comunicados institucionais e conteúdos para diferentes canais
Organizar eventos internos, ações de engajamento e reconhecimento
Apoiar iniciativas de onboarding e momentos-chave da jornada do colaborador Cultura e Engajamento
Apoiar ações que fortaleçam a cultura organizacional
Contribuir com iniciativas de clima e engajamento
Monitorar indicadores de comunicação e engajamento, propondo melhorias contínuas
Requisitos:
Formação em Comunicação, Marketing, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas
Experiência prévia com comunicação interna, endomarketing ou employer branding
Diferenciais
Experiência com gestão de redes sociais corporativas
Vivência com projetos de cultura organizacional ou experiência do colaborador
Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição (ex: Canva ou similares)
Vantagens/Benefícios:
Ticket Alimentação - pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
Refeição no local - para garantir refeições mais práticas e tranquilas no seu dia a dia.
Vale Transporte - para apoiar seu deslocamento no trajeto casa x trabalho x casa.
Assistência Médica - cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
Assistência Odontológica - cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
Cartão Farmácia – facilidade e conveniência para cuidar da sua saúde e bem-estar.
Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral - proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.
Wellhub (Gympass) - incentivo à prática de atividades físicas e ao bem-estar.

Horário de trabalho: segunda à sexta-feira, das 07h30 às 17h18.
Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

title: Designer de experiência do usuário
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Designer de Experiência do Usuário Sênior – Presencial (Centro/Rio de Janeiro)
Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 30 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Designer de Experiência do Usuário . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Experiência sólida como UX/UI Designer, Product Designer ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência com ferramentas de design e prototipação, como Figma;
Conhecimento em princípios de UX, como usabilidade, arquitetura da informação e design centrado no usuário;
Experiência nacriação de interfaces modernas e responsivas;
Vivência com criação e manutenção de design systems;
Capacidade de transformar requisitos de negócio em soluções de design eficientes;
Boa comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;
Visão crítica e orientada à melhoria contínua;

Experiência com sistemas corporativos, como intranets, portais internos, ITSM ou sistemas de RH;

Redesenhar fluxos de navegação e interação com foco em simplicidade, eficiência e usabilidade;

title: Especialista e analista sr- contabilidade
description:

Desejável pós-graduação ou MBA em Controladoria, Finanças, IFRS ou áreas correlatas

Conhecimento de normas internacionais (IFRS), especialmente IFRS 17, 9, 15 e 16;

Analisar as operações societárias de empresas coligadas e controladas, inclusive para fins de equivalência patrimonial e consolidação;

Elaborar memorandos técnicos/contábeis.

title: Customer success specialist, life sciences
description:
Jo VE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use Jo VE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of Sao Paulo, Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.
The Role
As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate Jo VE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their Jo VE subscription.

Please share your resume in English.
Responsibilities:
Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up Jo VE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
Increase Jo VE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of Jo VE resources.
Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.
Requirements:
A master's degree or Ph D in Life Science disciplines.
Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
Fluent communication skills English.
Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i. E. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.
Why Join Jo VE?
You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. - GPS

- Sirenes

title: Desenvolvedor .net / aws pleno
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital
Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.
Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.
BRQ WAY
No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!
É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.
Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!
- O que procuramos?
Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!
Requisitos Técnicos:
Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços backend utilizando. NET (C#)
Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e performáticas
Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em. NET / C#
Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, Postgre SQL, etc.)
Experiência com APIs RESTful
Familiaridade com práticas de versionamento (Git) e integração contínua
Experiência com cloud (AWS)
Desejáveis:
Experiência com mensageria (Rabbit MQ, Kafka, etc.)
Conhecimento em outras linguagens como Node. Js, Python ou Go
Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes)
Ter experiência em meios de pagamento
Vaga Híbrida, 2x em Rio de Janeiro - RJ
- O que temos pra te oferecer?
Mais do que um plano de carreira!
A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:
Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!
Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.
Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.
Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.
- E os benefícios?
Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!
- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?
Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube. Com/brqdigitalsolutions
Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Comprador
description:
Missão do cargo: Assegurar o abastecimento dos insumos de produção e demais materiais utilizados pela empresa, ao menor preço possível, dentro dos padrões estabelecidos de prazo e qualidade dos produtos e serviços.

Negociação de contrato de serviços, bem como, condução e gestão de licitações.

Negociar com os fornecedores, visando ao fechamento de compras dentro das melhores condições de preço, qualidade e prazo de entrega.
Analisar fretes, monitorar requisições, pedidos e solucionar eventuais divergências e aprovações no sistema.
Emitir os pedidos de compra e encaminhá-los aos fornecedores, fazendo o acompanhamento do processo de entrega e cumprimento final de todas as condições negociadas.
Pesquisar novos fornecedores de produtos e serviços diversos, visando desenvolver fontes alternativas de suprimentos.
Pesquisar produtos alternativos, conforme as possibilidades do processo produtivo, visando melhorar a qualidade do produto e reduzir custos de produção.
Fazer o acompanhamento dos pedidos, visando assegurar sua entrega no prazo estabelecido.
Coordenar os processos de importação de mercadorias, desde a compra dos produtos até o desembaraço aduaneiro final e entrega / recebimento.
Acompanhar o processo de devolução de mercadorias entregues em desacordo com o pedido.
Atualizar as tabelas de preços de mercadorias com os fornecedores e repassando internamente a informação aos setores envolvidos.

Contribuir com o planejamento estratégico visando o melhor funcionamento do setor e cumprimento dos prazos e metas.

Cadastrar novos fornecedores para consultas e cotações, conforme necessário.
Efetuar avaliação dos fornecedores, considerando performance e níveis de atendimento e serviço.
Elaborar contratos de prestação de serviço e fornecimento de materiais, visando otimizar as negociações e gerando savings para a empresa. Seguir indicadores de performance da equipe, como também os individuais, a fim de buscar a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados.
Requisitos:
Formação de nível superior completa.
Conhecimento de processos de licitação, importações e gerenciamento de contratos.
Conhecimento de Pacote Office (Excel).
Inglês Avançado.
Diferencial:
Conhecimento em Power BI . Experiência com compras em óleo e gás e/ou área naval.
Pós-graduação na área.

title: Project accountant

E. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

title: Analista de contratos de obra ii
description:
Descrição da vaga
SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA
A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).
Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.
Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.
Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!
ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.
Responsabilidades e atribuições Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contract Manager para realizar a gestão estratégica de um portfólio de contratos pertencentes a um ou mais Projetos de Capital da empresa, dentro da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia. A atuação se dará durante todo o ciclo de vida do contrato, atuando nos seguintes pilares:
Gerenciamento de riscos contratuais e de projetos;
Gestão de alterações contratuais (análise de mérito e valor para change order, Claim, back charge);
Gestão de conflitos (negociações, análise de cenários para tomada de decisão);
Gestão de registros;
Gestão das relações com as partes interessadas (internas e externas).
No setor de Engenharia, essa posição irá atuar na equipe do projeto, reportando-se aos Project Managers, atuando de maneira transversal entre as disciplinas nos projetos, com reporte duplo à Gerência Corporativa de Contratos e Riscos. A função atuará de forma integrativa, garantindo comunicação fluida e tomadas de decisão de forma multidisciplinar.
Objetivo estratégico: melhorar a previsibilidade e assertividade dos resultados dos projetos em questão, através da prevenção de desvios contratuais e predição das tendências identificadas na gestão de riscos.
Responsabilidades:
Monitoramento e controle dos indicadores contratuais a nível contrato e projeto;
Gestão/mediação de negociações e conflitos;
Zelar pelo cumprimento da governança e procedimentos de gestão de contratos e riscos;
Realizar reporting executivo em frequência adequada (indicadores, status de conflitos sob gestão da área, negociações pré-contratação, tendências identificadas em fase de implantação, etc).
Gestão de registros realizados através de instrumentos contratuais e de comunicação (RDO, atas, cartas, e-mails, relatórios), realizando análise dos registros, definição de respostas e casos prioritários.
Gestão de escopo, identificando potenciais desvios (técnicos ou contratuais), monitorando prazos, obrigações e responsabilidades das partes do contrato.
Requisitos e Qualificações:
Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou afins;
Experiência sólida em gestão/administração de contratos e negociação;
Conhecimento e/ou experiências em gestão de riscos contratuais;
Habilidade de liderança, visão sistêmica, capacidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis, criação de sinergia entre grupos de trabalho.
Disponibilidade para atuar em Recife - PE
Diferenciais:
Conhecimento e/ou experiência envolvendo: gestão de disputas, arbitragens e/ou de projetos, formação de preço/orçamento, planejamento, gestão de custos;
Pós-graduação ou certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, RMP, IPMA, CCM, etc.);
Experiência com projetos de transmissão;
Vivência em ambientes com cultura Lean e foco em melhoria contínua.
Informações adicionais
Benefícios:
Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. Alguns dos benefícios que disponibilizamos estão disponíveis abaixo:
- Vale-refeição e vale-alimentação;
- Plano Médico e Odontológico;
- Seguro de Vida;
- Previdência Privada;
- Vale-Transporte;
- Wellhub;
- Auxílio-creche;
- Auxílio-educacional;
Se esses benefícios e essa posição fazem sentido para você, inscreva-se já!
#Somos AXIAEnergia

title: Controllership coordinator
description:
Position Title: Controllership Coordinator Location: Rio de Janeiro – Brazil Reporting To: Finance Manager Hybrid: 3 days office/ 2 home
We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals and particularly encourage applications from people with disabilities (Pc D). Reasonable adjustments can be made throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace where required.

Prepare Financial Statements in local GAAP and IFRS, including interim and final financial statements with supporting schedules;
Assist and cooperate with the implementation of IFS system and maintenance of Alterdata system from Finance standpoint;
Key person in terms of accounting practices and corporate accounting rules & policies;

Fixed Assets and Inventory controls and registrations.

Control and preparation of GL entries including prepaid, accruals, allocations, etc.
Provide detailed analysis of GL entries on costs and revenue;
Work on the monthly, quarterly and yearly end closing diligently according to the corporate deadlines
Reconciliates, coordinates and preparation of associated balance sheet notes.
Assist project teams on the evaluation of margins of proper revenue and costs recognition following IFRS rules.
Cash flow forecast assistance as well as coordinate AP/AR routines.
Any other finance related tasks and duties that might be needed.

Experience in an accounting firm, major law firm, and in industry, preferably an Oil and Gas corporation.
Knowledge of IFRS and CPCs
CRC registration
(CPA) – desirable

Strong communication skills and ability to articulate complex accounting and both in Portuguese and in English.

title: Operations assistant – rezeption & buchhaltung
description:
Über Digital Studio RioDigital Studio Rio unterstützt gastorientierte Betriebe mit modernen, digitalen Prozessen, klarer Kommunikation und verlässlichen Abläufen. Wir arbeiten serviceorientiert, pragmatisch und strukturiert – mit dem Ziel, dass im Hintergrund alles sauber funktioniert und Gäste sowie Teams sich auf reibungslose Prozesse verlassen können. Deine Mission
Du unterstützt unser Team in Rio in einer zentralen Backend-Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Rezeption, Gästeservice und Buchhaltung.
Dein Schwerpunkt liegt darauf, dass Buchungen, Folios, Zahlungen, Rückerstattungen und backendseitige Abläufe korrekt und nachvollziehbar bearbeitet werden.
Gleichzeitig bist du in der Lage, bei Bedarf auch operativ zu unterstützen und als Backup für die Rezeption bzw. Gästekommunikation einzuspringen. Deine Aufgaben
Bearbeitung und Prüfung von Folios, Buchungsdaten und Zahlungsinformationen im Backend
Kontrolle, ob backendseitig alle Vorgänge rund um Buchungen korrekt angelegt und verarbeitet sind
Bearbeitung von Rückerstattungen, Gutschriften und ähnlichen Zahlungsvorgängen
Abstimmung zwischen Rezeption / Gästeservice und Buchhaltung
Klärung von Unstimmigkeiten bei Zahlungen, Buchungen oder Abrechnungen
Pflege und strukturierte Dokumentation von Abläufen, Informationen und internen Standards
Unterstützung bei administrativen Aufgaben rund um Buchungen und Gästeprozesse
Bei Bedarf Backup-Unterstützung für die Rezeption, z. B. bei Gästefragen oder operativen Engpässen
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem bestehenden Team in Rio Das bringst du mit
Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B1-Niveau, schriftlich und mündlich
Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
Gutes Verständnis für administrative und backendseitige Abläufe
Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, Systemen und standardisierten Prozessen
Fähigkeit, sauber, konzentriert und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten
Bereitschaft, sich in neue Systeme und Abläufe einzuarbeiten
Teamfähigkeit und klare Kommunikation Große Vorteile für diese Rolle
Erfahrung in Buchhaltung, vorbereitender Buchhaltung oder Abrechnung
Verständnis für die Schnittstelle zwischen operativem Betrieb und Finance/Buchhaltung
Erfahrung mit Rückerstattungen, Zahlungsabgleichen oder Buchungskontrolle
Erfahrung in Hotellerie, Rezeption, Reservierung oder Gästeservice
Kenntnisse in DATEV sind ideal, aber keine Voraussetzung
Wichtig ist vor allem die Bereitschaft, sich strukturiert einzuarbeiten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen Rahmenbedingungen

Role Overview:
As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.
• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Able seaman
description:
Position: Able Seaman Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias
About Us MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 57 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose The Able Seaman supports deck operations, ensuring proper maintenance and operation of deck equipment, lifting appliances, and lifesaving systems. The role contributes to cargo handling, emergency preparedness, and compliance with safety and operational standards onboard.
Key Responsibilities Inspect, test, and operate survival craft, rescue boats, and other lifesaving appliances in accordance with the maintenance plan;
Assist in material handling and lifting operations onboard;
Support housekeeping activities and waste management, including proper segregation and disposal;
Operate pedestal crane for ship-to-ship operations in the absence of the designated Crane Operator (e. G., during rest periods), subject to required qualifications;
Operate electro-mechanical lifting equipment (excluding pedestal cranes);
Participate actively in emergency response activities, including fire drills, abandon ship drills, and other onboard emergency procedures;
Maintain lifeboats, liferafts, and other safety equipment in a state of readiness;
Ensure familiarity with all safety equipment and applicable procedures onboard;
Perform routine maintenance tasks such as chipping, painting, cleaning, and greasing;
Maintain deck equipment and carry out minor repairs as required.
Requirements Valid certification as Able Seaman (in accordance with STCW requirements);
Previous offshoreexperience (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Experience with deck operations and lifting equipment;
Familiarity with safety procedures and emergency response onboard;
Good level of physical fitness and ability to work in offshore conditions;
Basic English communication skills (minimum intermediate level preferred);
Strong teamwork, discipline, and safety-oriented mindset.
Benefits Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
About Reboot Monkey
Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide. We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
About the Role
Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.
As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try. This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT or managed DCTs directly . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management. What You'll Do
Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region
Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords
Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score
Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history
Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria
Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training
Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team
Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region
Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them
Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings
Requirements
3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)
Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills
Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring
Fluent written and spoken English
Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision
Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

title: Especialista de operações (supply chain) - Época cosméticos
description:
Sobre nós Somos uma das primeiras lojas de beleza online do país, com mais de 11 anos de mercado. Em 2013, passamos a fazer parte do Grupo Magalu e, hoje, somos o e-commerce com o mix de produtos mais completo da internet. Vendemos as maiores marcas nacionais e internacionais de perfumes, maquiagens, cosméticos e muito mais. A empresa fica na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, porém a alocação pode acontecer na cidade de São Paulo.Descrição do Cargo Como será o seu dia a dia S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning): Conduzir e aprimorar os ciclos de S&OP, alinhando as previsões de vendas (Demand Planning) com a execução operacional, mitigando riscos e identificando oportunidades de melhoria contínua. Foco no Cliente (Nível de Serviço): Monitorar indicadores de performance de entrega (como OTIF - On Time In Full), garantindo a excelência na experiência do consumidor final, seja no e-commerce ou no abastecimento de lojas físicas. Gestão de Fretes (Prazos e Custos): Analisar e otimizar a malha logística. Equilibrar a equação de Transit Time (prazo) x Custo de Frete, apoiando negociações com transportadoras e buscando rotas mais eficientes. Controle e Estratégia de Estoque: Definir políticas de estoque de segurança, monitorar o giro de produtos e gerenciar o risco de obsolescência/vencimento (shelf-life). Prevenir rupturas (stockout) e excessos (overstock).
Planejamento de Capacidade: Analisar a capacidade de armazenagem (CDs), picking/packing (separação e embalagem) e escoamento (expedição), dimensionando a operação para suportar picos de demanda e campanhas promocionais. Precisamos que você já tenha: Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Logística, etc.), Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Gestão e matemática de Estoques.
Composição de custos de frete e roteirização.
